stories.title: Abhinava Rizel: EV motors
stories.link_basis: Brochure says the founders are alumni of the Mechanical and Automotive departments.

facts.text: Developed electric-vehicle motors using a hybrid radial-flux design between synchronous reluctance (SynRM) and permanent-magnet synchronous (PMSM) motors.
Reports 8 patents filed and another 10 under filing for EV motor and powertrain technology.
Secured an investment from MM Forgings Ltd.
Founded by alumni of the Mechanical and Automotive departments.

stories.title: Torus Robotics: defence ground vehicles
stories.link_basis: Brochure says the founders are alumni of the Mechatronics department.

facts.text: Designs and delivers fully electric unmanned ground vehicles with a 6-degree-of-freedom robotic arm for Indian defence services.
Recognised by IDEX-DIO as a Pioneer Defence Innovator.
Signed an MOU with BEML at the Aero India 2021 expo to develop an AI-based unmanned ground vehicle (2021).
Founded by alumni of the Mechatronics department.

stories.title: Neur Industries: AR/VR, motors and actuators
stories.link_basis: Brochure says the founders are alumni of the Mechatronics department.

facts.text: Works on AR/VR, motors and actuators; its Neur XR Studios builds enterprise XR solutions.
Grew from three founders to a team of 20 and is bootstrapped, per the brochure.
Reports over 100 enterprise solutions deployed.
Founded by alumni of the Mechatronics department.

stories.title: Weezy Streetwear: fast fashion
stories.link_basis: Brochure says the founder was a student of the ECE department.

facts.text: A fast-fashion label reporting a customer cohort of 12,000+.
Reports raising Rs 70 lakh through an angel pre-seed round and the Startup India Seed Fund Scheme.
Founded by a student of the ECE department.

stories.title: Paperplane: digital clinics on WhatsApp
stories.link_basis: Brochure names the School of Computing, not a programme.

facts.text: Lets doctors and hospitals run digital clinics on WhatsApp, automating appointments, prescriptions and follow-ups.
Reports raising Rs 3 crore in a round led by Cornerstone Venture Partners Fund.
Founded by students of the School of Computing.

stories.title: SureLocal: pharmacy supply chain
stories.link_basis: Founder studied at the School of Pharmacy, outside the B.Tech programmes.

facts.text: A B2B commerce company helping pharma retailers with technology and supply chain, focused on tier 2 and tier 3 cities.
Reports raising USD 1 million from an angel investor.
Founded by a student of the School of Pharmacy.

stories.title: Team Camber Racing: Formula Student
stories.link_basis: SRM page places the team in the Department of Automobile Engineering. Other departments are NOT confirmed.

facts.text: Won the Combustion category at Formula Bharat 2026, per Evo India.
Team Camber Racing is listed under the Department of Automobile Engineering.
Formula Student Germany describes the team as undergraduates from a range of engineering disciplines (departments not named).
